steps.label: Lay the pistol on the work mat
Untie and unroll the toolkit
Set the servo, the two alloy sheets and the nanite vial in the tray
Pick up the vial that rolled off
Three test pulses at the card

actions.line: Fire three test pulses at the card: aim at the rings and click

steps.label: Pick the pistol up and shake it
Thumb the latch and pull the charge cell
Set the frame in the vise and close it snug
Snip the two wire twists holding the old grip
Peel the tape and leather wrap

actions.line: Hold the left button on the wrap and keep moving the mouse: the tape peels off as the vise turns

steps.label: Take out the upper grip screw
The lower screw is seized: oil it, tap it, then take it out
The slot is rounded: turn it out with pliers
Lift off the left and right scales, set them on the parts mat
Pinch the tab and pull the trigger lead off the cell bus
Drive the housing pin out with punch and mallet, pull it with pliers
The pin is bent: tap it straight on the vise's anvil
Slide the backstrap housing off its rail, keeping a thumb on the spring
The spring jumped: find it on the bench
Turn the bare frame over and find the cracked tang
Move the frame to the cradle stand; clamp the servo
Brush the caked dust off the case to find the screws and seam
Three case screws, cross bit
One head is already chewed: grip it with pliers and turn
Lever the case open at three clips along the seam

actions.line: Open the vise a little: hold left on the handle and circle the mouse the other way
Turn the servo round in the vise: pick it up, turn it with the wheel, set it back in
Close the vise snug on the servo again: hold left on the handle and circle the mouse

steps.label: Snip the two coil leads and the sense lead at the board end, at the bands
Unplug and lift out the burnt control board, snip the trim resistor off it, bin the board
Spring the circlip off the gear post
The circlip flew: find it on the bench
Lift the three gears off, top first, bin them
Two trunnion screws, then lift the gimbal out with its leads
Wind the stator copper onto the bobbin: one Copper Filament to the pack
Swirl the gimbal in the solvent jar
Wire-brush the race and trunnions clean
Pick the grit out of three detents
One drop of oil on each trunnion
Flick the rotor and listen
It grinds: brush the race again
Trim the two coil leads to the mark; cut the sense lead off flush
The trigger lead is frayed: strip it back and twist the strands
Strip 8 mm off each coil lead and twist the strands
Tin both ends and the resistor's legs
A lead was cut short: splice it with one more joint
Join the two leads across the trim resistor, sleeve and shrink
Put the bench tester's probes across the resistor
No lamp: reflow the dull joint
Lay an old scale on the alloy as a template and scribe round it
Clamp both alloy sheets stacked, cut to the line
File the stacked edges to the line and break the corners
Centre-punch four hole marks through the scale's holes
Drill the four holes through both plates
Bend the alloy strip twice in the vise to make the strap
The strip cracked: bend the spare
Pick the pistol-tang mould from the rack, seat it in the press, brush it out
Lay the alloy offcuts in the cavity and pour the nanites to the line
Close and lock the press, pump to the green band and hold while the nanites knit
Vent, open, lift the core out with pliers and quench it
Knock the sprue off, file the flash off the parting line and ease the bearing pocket with the round file
Press the gimbal cradle home in the vise, stopping at the flush line
The lug cracked: mend it with a bead of nanites
Tuck the damper loop into the core's side channel until its two clips snap
Drop the rotor back into the gimbal and fit the retaining ring
The ring flew: find it and fit it again
Slide the strap over the spine until it clicks
Left plate on its pegs, turn the grip over, right plate on its pegs
Start the four servo screws by hand
Drive them home, then final torque each
Trace both plate seams with the nanite applicator
Swing the cure lamp over and wait ten seconds
Hold the grip and tilt it sharply
A lead is pinched: ease it back along its channel
Slide the grip up onto the frame tang
Feed the trigger lead down the grip's rear channel and plug it back onto the cell bus
Tap the housing pin back in
The pin stands proud: tap it flush
Two new grip screws from the dish, cross bit, to torque
Open the vise, clear the old grip into the scrap bin, lay the pistol on the mat, cell in, latch home
Pick the pistol up and look it over
Shake it
Three test pulses at a fresh card

actions.line: Fire three test pulses at the fresh card: aim at the rings and click

steps.label: Holster and step back
